text: rash: Heb. hasty | plainly: Or, elegantly
when the needy speaketh right: Or, he speaketh against the poor in judgment
days and years: Heb. days above a year
the pleasant fields: Heb. the fields of desire
yea upon: Or, burning upon. etc.
forts and towers: Or, clifts and watchtowers
and the city shall be in a low place: Or, and the city shall be utterly abased
